newsitem.title: USA: Medicaid foots bill for phony podiatrist bills.
newsitem.headline: Medicaid foots bill for phony podiatrist bills.

text.p: A podiatrist admitted luring Medicaid patients with free Chinese food then forcing Medicaid to foot the bill for unnecessary prescriptions, X-rays and services, New York's Attorney General said Monday.
Joanne Conte, 35, of Garden City, N.Y. pleaded guilty Friday in Kings County State Supreme Court to stealing $300,000 in Medicaid payments.

Attorney General Dennis Vacco said Conte and two defendants allegedly offered Medicaid patients free Chinese food and sometimes sneakers to come to a phony clinic. They then used the numbers on the patients' Medicaid cards to bill the system.
